gemv_m1.note: Triton M=1 GEMV on 3 shapes; L2 rel err 5e-6/1.9e-4/0; L4 same-tool A/B 64.32 -> 65.24 tok/s (+1.4%), 5 vs 3 runs, 512 prompt/1024 out PLANS holds TP8-local (N, K) shapes (16384/8, K/8, 1280/8).

ar_prefill.note: tried to size the PCIe-IPC workspace for prefill batches (it is max(capture_sizes)*hidden=16*2560 today, so every prefill AR falls back to NCCL). Enlarging the allocation only (no extra tuning) made prefill SLOWER: 2824 tok/s @7909 and 2612 @31595 vs baseline 3612 @8192 and 3074 @32768 (-15~22%). Root cause: the decode-tuned configs do not transfer to 21MB messages. Rejected 2026-10-26.

gdn_tc.note: tensor-core GDN chunk prefill (mma.sync m16n8k8, borrowed from vllm-turing). REQUIRES --gdn-prefill-backend=triton on the launch line. L2 parity 7.2e-04 vs flashqla; L3 teacher-forced logprob delta 0.0035 nats (noise band 0.002-0.005); L4 prefill +6.5%/+12.0%/+10.1% at ~8K/~32K/~126K.

ar_overlap.note: chunk RowParallelLinear over tokens and issue async all-reduce per chunk so the next chunk's GEMM overlaps the collective; return_bias layers (GDN out_proj) included. Same-image A/B on 2026-10-26: on 2306.6/10081.5 ms vs off 2266.7/10021.7 ms at ~7.9K/~31.6K (5-run medians) - no gain, slightly slower. Only ~48 of ~98 AR launches per prefill step are reachable here; MoE reduce (48) and embedding/PLE stay outside. Rejected under the 1% gate and left default-off.

ar_q8_probe.note: MEASUREMENT ONLY, not an optimization. Quantizes the row-parallel prefill output to fp8-e4m3 (per token) while the all-reduce itself stays fp16, to measure the precision cost an 8-bit collective would pay. Gate: run L3 teacher-forced logprobs with VLLM_SM75_AR_Q8_PROBE=0/1 and compare against the 0.002-0.005 nats noise band before writing any collective kernel.

note: gemv_m1 verified on 2026-10-26 under the 1% L4 gate (was 3%). Items 2/4/6 are already fused upstream and stay out. ar_q8_probe is a measurement gate, never auto-enabled.
